content:
alex: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem on the cache eviction spike. I list 3 remediation items below; need owners, JIRA links, and a concise RACI. Can folks confirm owners by EOD?

alex: Remediation candidates: 1) persistent cache TTL audit and policy, 2) eviction backpressure fix (throttling & batching), 3) cross-region failover runbook + automated test plan.

priya: I'll take #1 (TTL audit) and create the JIRA.

luke: I'll own #2 if eng-infra can assist with kernel/queue tuning. @maria can you be C for #2?

maria: I can consult on #2 but bandwidth is tight this sprint. If needed push due date 2w and I can allocate more time.

devon: I'll pick #3 (runbook + test automation). I'll make the ticket and add a checklist.

priya: Created REDWOOD-8419 for TTL audit: https://jira.company/REDWOOD-8419. ETA 2026-04-10. Looping in @luke for QA.

alex: Thanks. Quick RACI guidance: R=owner, A=approver, C=consulted, I=informed.

luke: Proposed RACI for clarity: #1 R=Priya, A=Alex, C=Eng-Infra (Maria), I=Support+SRE. #2 R=Luke, A=Eng-Platform lead (TBD), C=Maria, I=Ops. #3 R=Devon, A=Product, C=SRE, I=Oncall.

maria: I'm okay as C for #2 if we get infra early. If timeline slips, I can move to R.

devon: REDWOOD-8421 created for runbook + tests: https://jira.company/REDWOOD-8421. I'll include a small-scale rollback plan. ETA 2026-04-05.

opsbot: Reminder: tag tickets with `component=postmortem` and `severity=sev3`. Use the slash helper or add tags in the description.

alex: Example JIRA CLI to save time:
```
/jira create --project REDWOOD --summary "TTL audit for persistent cache" --component postmortem
```

priya: Added repro steps and prompt set to REDWOOD-8419. Also raising a recurring-pattern note: evictions spike when a few customers send very long sequences. We should add a per-customer token-length metric.

luke: Agreed. I'll open REDWOOD-8430 for a monitoring rule: alert when per-customer 95th percentile token-length > threshold over 5m.

maria: Proposed dates if owners confirmed now: #1 due 2026-04-10, #2 due 2026-04-17, #3 due 2026-04-05. Are these workable?

alex: Those look fine. I'll update the postmortem doc and create calendar invites. Please add any blockers in the JIRA comments. Thanks all :thumbsup:

priya: :thumbsup: I'll keep status updates in the ticket.

devon: I'll add automated test cases to REDWOOD-8421 by EOD tomorrow.

luke: I'll follow up with eng-infra for a small allocation to investigate kernel/queue behavior.

maria: If you need me to escalate for extra capacity, DM me.

alex: I'll mark this thread as the canonical follow-up once tickets have owners and dates. Closing loop after JIRA links are in place.
